# Move RIGHT repeatedly, track green count and hull position at each step
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    greens=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=20]

for i in range(4):

    res=action(['RIGHT'])
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'):

        break
print('final:', state())
